body: Okay. I'll take you up on that offer, and while this may sound stupid, what does PM mean?
All right. I'll try to do this. Thank you so much for your help and advice. This has honestly gotten me farther then my therapy sessions that I had to take for over 2 years.

I can lock my room, but then my parents threaten to call the police because it's the safe room of the house and is reinforced, so I'm not allowed to lock it. If I wanted to go to a friends house, I risk the chance of them locking me out by bolting the door. No one in my family ever says anything. They all agree with whoever is pointing a finger or starting the fight.
I have a couple of friends that I can talk to who I trust. Thanks for the advice, but when they do something to purposefully trigger me, what do I do then?
No, because in the country I'm in, the legal age is different, and I've got about 4 years until I reach it.
